confirm.title: Qingping Air Monitor Lite discovered
confirm.description: A Qingping (MAC {mac}) publishes on your MQTT broker. Add it?

user.title: Qingping Air Monitor Lite
user.description: Pick a Qingping found on MQTT.

manual.title: Qingping Air Monitor Lite
manual.description: No Qingping heard on MQTT within 10 s. Enter the MAC address manually (as used in qingping/MAC/up).

bt_setup.title: Set up over Bluetooth
bt_setup.description:
A Qingping Air Monitor Lite in pairing mode was found over Bluetooth ({ble_address}, Wi-Fi MAC {mac}).

Enter the Wi-Fi network it should join and your MQTT broker. Use the broker's **LAN IP address** and a dedicated MQTT user for the monitors. The details are written to the device over Bluetooth only: no Qingping account or cloud is involved, and the passwords are not stored in Home Assistant.

Make sure the monitor still shows the large Wi-Fi icon (hold the top bar ~8 s if not).

bt_timeout.title: No message from the monitor yet
bt_timeout.description:
The settings were written, but nothing arrived on `{topic}` within {seconds} seconds.

Check: Wi-Fi name/password (2.4 GHz), broker IP reachable from the monitor's network, MQTT user/password and ACL (write `qingping/+/up`, read `qingping/+/down`), and the Mosquitto log.

Submit to add the device anyway (it comes online by itself once it connects), or close this dialog, put the monitor in pairing mode again and retry.

abort.already_in_progress: Setup for this Qingping is already in progress.

progress.writing: Writing Wi-Fi and MQTT settings to the monitor over Bluetooth…
progress.waiting: Waiting for the monitor to join Wi-Fi and publish on {topic} (up to 2 minutes)…

confirm.title: {name}: temperature step corrected
confirm.description:
On {time} the temperature jumped {delta} °C between two readings (not physically possible). The integration absorbed the jump; current step correction is {correction} °C.

Submit to acknowledge. Tick the box to reset the correction to 0 (if the level after the jump is the correct one).

offline.title: {name} is offline
offline.description: No MQTT message from {name} ({mac}) for more than {minutes} minutes. Check power/USB and WiFi. This message disappears automatically when the device reports again.

sensor_fault.title: {name}: sensor fault
sensor_fault.description: The device reports a non-zero status for: {sensors}. This message disappears automatically when all sensors report OK.
